items.name: Next franchise sites from customer and franchise locations
items.statement: Choose the areas for the next franchise openings. A site opened where customers already travel far to buy wins sales others cannot reach.

items.name: Sales by place and the areas that stand out
items.statement: Show franchise sales by area and name the areas that need a regional plan. Regional plans built on the map put effort where sales are thin.

items.name: Recurring complaint reasons from reviews
items.statement: Fix the top growing complaint reasons in reviews, each with an owner. A growing complaint caught early costs a recipe change; caught late it costs customers.

items.name: Franchises below the network on review sentiment
items.statement: Coach the franchises whose review sentiment runs below their peers. Sentiment below peers predicts lost repeat customers at that franchise.

items.name: Daily demand forecast per franchise and product
items.statement: Set each franchise's daily bake quantity per product. Over-baking is waste and under-baking is lost sales, every day.

items.name: Franchises that depend on one supplier
items.statement: Qualify a second supplier for the franchises and ingredients that depend on one supplier. One supplier failing stops every franchise that depends on it.

items.name: Customer lapse risk from purchase history
items.statement: Choose which customers get a win-back offer this week. Winning back a lapsing customer costs less than finding a new one.

items.name: Customer segments from purchase behavior
items.statement: Pick the customer segments for each loyalty offer. Offers tuned per segment earn more than one offer for all.

items.name: Next product to offer each customer
items.statement: Choose the next product to offer each customer. A relevant next offer lifts basket size; an irrelevant one trains customers to ignore offers.

items.name: Staffing per franchise by hour
items.statement: Set staff per franchise and hour from expected traffic. Queues at peak hours lose sales; idle staff off-peak lose margin.

items.name: Payment cards shared across customers
items.statement: Review the card numbers used by many customers or franchises before the next payout. Cards shared across many customers point to fraud or data errors, and both need a person to look.

items.name: Customer lifetime value
items.statement: Set the loyalty investment per customer value tier. Loyalty spend on low-value customers is taken from the ones worth keeping.

items.name: Revenue change by price, volume and product mix
items.statement: Explain each month's revenue change by price, volume and mix per franchise. Without the split, a mix shift looks like a demand problem.
